name: Alpinarium Galtür
kurzbeschreibung: Alpinarium Galtür in the Paznaun Valley is an award-winning museum and memorial built directly into a massive 345-metre avalanche defense wall.
preis: Admission charges apply (discounts with Silvretta Card guest passes)
oeffnungszeiten: Open early June to mid-October and mid-December through April
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Alpinarium Galtür, situated at the head of the high-alpine Paznaun Valley, is a globally unique cultural landmark and architectural marvel. Established following the devastating avalanche of February 1999, the institution uniquely fuses functional civil engineering with an evocative memorial museum: the entire structure is seamlessly embedded inside a monumental avalanche defense barrier measuring 345 metres in length and up to 19 metres in height, safeguarding the village of Galtür. Its internationally acclaimed core exhibition, 'AT THE VERY TOP. On Galtür and the World', uses multimedia narratives to explore humanity's delicate coexistence with formidable mountain forces. Exhibits range from the medieval arrival of the Walser settlers and the dawn of alpine expeditions to contemporary climate research and cutting-edge avalanche management.

Route & Anforderungen

A visit to the Alpinarium is completely weatherproof, year-round enjoyable, and fully accessible thanks to contemporary universal barrier-free architecture. All exhibition levels, the welcoming 'Frozen Waters' café, and the panoramic observation decks are reached via step-free corridors and elevators accommodating strollers and wheelchairs effortlessly. Guests should set aside approximately one and a half to two hours to absorb the immersive audiovisual galleries. Externally, the exposed concrete exterior incorporates an engineered climbing wall featuring dedicated bouldering sections popular during the summer months. Regular street attire and casual footwear are entirely sufficient.

Besuch & Anreise

Galtür is situated at an elevation of 1,584 metres near the Silvretta mountain passes. Drivers travel via motorway A12 and the S16 Arlberg express road (exit Pians), ascending federal road B188 through the Paznaun Valley past Ischgl straight to Galtür village center. Designated parking spaces are provided next to the museum. By public transit, rail travelers alight at Landeck-Zams station and board synchronized regional bus line 260 directly to Galtür village square.

Tipps

Conclude your gallery tour with a visit to the café situated atop the protective avalanche rampart. Enjoying artisan cakes and coffee while overlooking the snowfields of the Silvretta Alps is an unforgettable highlight. During summer, pair the museum with a scenic hike towards the Jamtalhütte or the Silvretta Reservoir.
